title: MCP Servers Manifest
description: Single source of truth for every published @hiberus-magento MCP server package. Validated in CI; README.md is generated from this file and never hand-edited.

id.description: Stable slug used as the packages/<id> directory name.

bin.description: The CLI binary name exposed by package.json's bin field.

version.description: Exact published version, e.g. for consumer configuration snippets to pin against.

domain.description: Product domain this server talks to, e.g. eds, aco.

status.description: internal: never published (e.g. fixture-server). planned: not yet built. alpha: published but unstable. published: stable.

docs.description: Optional relative path or URL to further documentation.

env.description: Every environment variable the server's own sources read, required and optional alike. Checked against those sources by scripts/manifest-env.test.mjs.

required.description: true only when the server refuses to do its work without this variable. false when it merely enables or overrides behaviour, OR when it is one of several alternatives — this schema cannot express "one of these", so an alternation is stated in `description` and every member is `required: false`.

description.description: What the variable does and what happens when it is absent. For an alternative, name the other way to satisfy the same need.
